review_description: Cannot find a better Tradesman. Installation perfect. Price a bit high, but got my monies worth with the best job ever.  After sales service second to none. Great clean and tidy job. Thanks Andrew and Markus.

Andrew Logan is very knowledgeable about solar installations and keeps up to date on the latest developments. While his quotes are slightly higher than some they are very detailed. He has high standards which is evidenced in the quality of work he performs.
Be careful with quotes only emailed as they have hard to find extra costs in the fine print. Go with someone whos prepared to visit the site and provides backup support.
